description_en: Describes the current bandwidth of a Tair (Redis-compatible) instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例当前的带宽
name: DescribeIntranetAttribute

AutoRenewal.description_en:
Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled for the bandwidth package. Valid values:

true: Auto-renewal is enabled.

false: Auto-renewal is disabled.

This parameter is not returned if no additional bandwidth is purchased
AutoRenewal.description_zh:
购买的带宽是否开启了自动续订，取值：
true：已开启。
false：未开启。

如果未购买带宽，则不返回本参数

BandwidthExpireTime.description_en:
The expiration time of the bandwidth package. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format.

This parameter is not returned if no additional bandwidth is purchased
BandwidthExpireTime.description_zh: 购买带宽的过期时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。 如果实例未购买额外的带宽，则不返回本参数

BandwidthPrePaid.description_en:
The billing method of the bandwidth package. Valid values:

0: pay-as-you-go.

1: subscription
BandwidthPrePaid.description_zh:
带宽包付费类型，取值：
0：按量付费。
1：预付费

ExpireTime.description_en:
The expiration time of the temporary bandwidth. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format.

This parameter returns 0 if the instance has no temporary bandwidth or if the temporary bandwidth has expired
ExpireTime.description_zh: 临时带宽的过期时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。 如果实例未执行过临时调整带宽或临时带宽已过期，本参数返回0

HasPrePaidBandWidthOrderRunning.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance has an unexpired bandwidth package. Valid values:

true: An unexpired bandwidth package exists.

false: No unexpired bandwidth package exists.

This parameter is not returned if no additional bandwidth is purchased
HasPrePaidBandWidthOrderRunning.description_zh:
实例是否有未到期的带宽包，取值：
true：存在未到期的带宽包。
false：不存在未到期的带宽包。
如果实例未购买额外的带宽，则不返回本参数

IntranetBandwidth.description_en: The total intranet bandwidth across all shards in the instance, in MB/s
IntranetBandwidth.description_zh: 实例当前的内网带宽，本参数为实例中所有分片的带宽总和，单位MB/s
